_meta.doctrine: dumped from the live Python loaders after the boot sequence

alchemy_antidote.narrative: Living ichor purges toxins from blood. Light gem illuminates and neutralizes poison. Simple but effective - corruption burns away.

alchemy_armor_polish.narrative: Limestone grinds to powder. Light gem infuses protective shimmer. Slime gel binds into paste. Sheen turns blades.

alchemy_berserker_rage.narrative: Dire fangs release primal fury. Fire crystals ignite rage. Storm heart adds raw power. Living ichor binds controlled chaos. Unleash inner beast.

alchemy_crystallize_fire.narrative: Limestone dissolves, creating crystalline matrix. Phoenix ash ignites transformation. Chaos becomes order - heat solidifies into stable crystal.

alchemy_crystallize_lightning.narrative: Storm heart provides raw lightning. Crystal quartz captures and stabilizes. Electricity crystallizes into solid form.

alchemy_efficiency_oil.narrative: Slime gel creates slick base. Spectral thread adds supernatural efficiency. Water crystal prevents evaporation. Productivity soars.

alchemy_elemental_harmony.narrative: Fire then water - must balance before adding earth. Air completes cycle. Balance in bottle - all elements recognize you as kin.

alchemy_fire_resistance_potion.narrative: Water crystals create cooling base. Frost essence adds cold countering flame. Slime gel binds protection to skin. Fire cannot touch you.

alchemy_frost_resistance_potion.narrative: Fire crystals generate inner warmth. Phoenix ash adds perpetual heat never fading. Slime gel spreads throughout body. Cold cannot touch you.

alchemy_greater_health_potion.narrative: Essence blood provides foundation. Light gem illuminates and purifies. Living ichor amplifies. Miss a peak, lose potency - catch them all, wounds close rapidly.

alchemy_haste_potion.narrative: Air crystal creates speed foundation. Lightning shard adds electric quickness. Spectral thread binds temporal acceleration. Move like lightning.

alchemy_health_potion.narrative: Living ichor provides life force base. Water crystals amplify properties. Slime gel completes stabilization. Each stage must settle before next.

alchemy_invisibility_potion.narrative: Shadow cores create concealment base. Spectral thread bends light around you. Void essence completes erasure. Living ichor binds to living form. You become absence.

alchemy_iron_skin_potion.narrative: Iron scales dissolve into liquid stone base. Earth crystal adds flexible protection. Golem core solidifies without rigidity. Skin hardens like metal.

alchemy_levitation_elixir.narrative: Air crystals deny gravity. Spectral thread lightens physical form. Void essence completes separation from earth. Living ichor binds to body. You float.

alchemy_liquid_courage.narrative: Slime gel creates base. Fire crystal adds warming confidence. Simple but effective - fear melts away.

alchemy_mana_potion.narrative: Crystal quartz creates magical base, pure potential. Light gems infuse arcane energy. Water crystals stabilize volatile magic into drinkable form. Mana floods back.

alchemy_minor_health_potion.narrative: Slime gel dissolves first, creating restorative base. Wolf pelt binds mixture second. Watch for gentle green glow - too quick and they won't merge.

alchemy_night_vision_elixir.narrative: Light gems infuse eyes with illumination. Shadow core teaches seeing through darkness. Living ichor carries to vision. Darkness becomes irrelevant.

alchemy_philosophers_stone.narrative: Gold base for perfection. Dragon scale adds ancient power. Essence blood provides life. Void essence enables transmutation. Phoenix ash grants rebirth. Storm heart completes opus. Magnum achievement of alchemy.

alchemy_poison_vial.narrative: Dire fangs release venom. Shadow core amplifies toxicity. Slime gel stabilizes for storage. Coat weapons with deadly brew.

alchemy_refine_essence_blood.narrative: Living ichor provides raw life force. Light gems purify and concentrate. Pure essence emerges - no impurities, pure vitality.

alchemy_regeneration_tonic.narrative: Living ichor creates sustained healing potential. Light gems infuse persistent illumination. Essence blood binds regenerative effect. Body remembers how to heal continuously.

alchemy_strength_elixir.narrative: Dire fangs dissolve first, releasing strength essence. Fire crystals amplify power. Beetle carapace adds durability to effect. Too early blocks absorption, too late makes it brief.

alchemy_swiftness_draught.narrative: Air crystals create fluid motion essence. Spectral thread lightens body, quickens reflexes. Slime gel binds to living form. World seems to slow.

alchemy_titans_brew.narrative: Golem core provides titan strength. Storm heart adds raw power. Phoenix ash ensures perpetual effect. Essence blood binds all. You feel unstoppable.

alchemy_transmute_copper_tin.narrative: Copper dissolves first into base form. Fire crystal catalyzes transformation to tin. Foundation of alchemical wealth.

alchemy_transmute_iron_steel.narrative: Iron dissolves to potential. Coal provides carbon. Fire crystal bonds them into steel. Alchemy surpasses forging.

alchemy_universal_solvent.narrative: Void essence unmakes matter. Shadow cores channel dissolution. Voidstone stabilizes impossible. Miss timing, dissolves cauldron itself.

alchemy_water_breathing_potion.narrative: Water crystals attune body to aquatic existence. Air crystals teach lungs extracting oxygen from water. Living ichor completes transformation. Breathe liquid as air.

engineering_auto_collector.narrative: Automated collector - iron houses mechanism, light gem identifies targets, spectral thread extends reach, slime gel provides adhesive grip. Saves countless trips.

engineering_basic_arrow_turret.narrative: Basic arrow turret - iron frame for stability, oak mechanism for firing, beetle carapace provides spring tension. Point away from face.

engineering_bear_trap.narrative: Bear trap - steel forms jaw mechanism, dire fangs form serrated edges. Once closed, nothing escapes. Perfect spring tension required.

engineering_cluster_bomb.narrative: Cluster bomb - steel casing fragments, blast powder creates multiple charges, air crystals ensure wide dispersal. Maximum coverage.

engineering_emp_device.narrative: EMP device - orichalcum frame channels energy, lightning shards provide pulse, storm heart amplifies. Technology's nightmare.

engineering_fire_arrow_turret.narrative: Fire arrow turret - steel frame withstands heat, birch mechanism fires, fire crystals ignite projectiles. Warm touch to home defense.

engineering_fire_bomb.narrative: Fire bomb - steel casing survives blast, blast powder creates explosion, fire crystals add burning. Melts stone.

engineering_flamethrower_turret.narrative: Flamethrower turret - steel frame withstands heat, fire crystals fuel inferno, phoenix ash ensures perpetual burn. Excellent crowd control.

engineering_frost_mine.narrative: Frost mine - iron casing protects mechanism, blast powder triggers, frost essence provides freezing blast. Bury and wait.

engineering_grappling_hook.narrative: Grappling hook - iron forms hook, spectral thread creates unbreakable line, air crystals enable vertical mobility. Hooks distant surfaces.

engineering_healing_beacon.narrative: Healing beacon - steel frame supports, light gems project aura, living ichor provides life force, water crystals extend radius. Continuous healing.

engineering_jetpack.narrative: Jetpack for brief flight - mithril frame lightweight, fire crystals provide thrust, air crystals stabilize, phoenix ash ensures sustained burn. Fuel not included.

engineering_laser_turret.narrative: Laser turret - mithril frame reflects energy, light gems provide power, crystal quartz lenses focus to cutting intensity. Precise and devastating.

engineering_lightning_cannon.narrative: Lightning cannon - mithril frame conducts perfectly, ironwood mechanism directs, lightning shards provide power, storm heart amplifies. Extremely effective, extremely dangerous.

engineering_net_launcher.narrative: Net launcher - iron frame launches, spectral thread forms unbreakable net, beetle carapace weights edges. Reduces movement dramatically.

engineering_poison_trap.narrative: Poison gas trap - iron casing contains, slime gel creates gas, shadow cores amplify toxicity. Choking clouds on trigger.

engineering_proximity_alarm.narrative: Proximity alarm - iron housing protects, light gem detects movement, beetle carapace creates sound. Simple but effective early warning.

engineering_repair_drone.narrative: Repair drone - mithril frame enables flight, light gem powers systems, spectral thread manipulates tools, living ichor enables restoration. Fixes what breaks.

engineering_resource_scanner.narrative: Scanner detecting resources - steel houses sensors, light gems power scanning, crystal quartz focuses detection, air crystals enable remote sensing. Knowledge is power.

engineering_shield_generator.narrative: Shield generator creating barrier - steel supports projectors, light gems power field, crystal quartz shapes barrier, water crystals distribute energy. Damage breaks on barrier.

engineering_simple_bomb.narrative: Simple explosive - iron casing contains, blast powder explodes. Universal problem solver.

engineering_slow_field_generator.narrative: Slow field generator - iron anchors reality, frost essence creates temporal drag, crystal projects field, water stabilizes. Everything moves through frozen honey.

engineering_spike_trap.narrative: Spike trap - iron base forms platform, steel spikes deliver damage, beetle carapace provides snap force. Simple but brutal.

engineering_teleporter.narrative: Teleporter folding space - etherion anchors reality, chaos matrix enables impossible, void essence tears dimensions, genesis lattice stabilizes. Science or magic? Yes.

engineering_void_bomb.narrative: Void bomb creating spatial tears - adamantine contains impossible, void essence tears reality, blast powder triggers, voidstone amplifies. Do not use indoors.

refining_adamantine_ore_to_ingot.narrative: Smelting adamantine. Extreme heat required - cylinders groan under strain.

refining_ash_log_to_plank.narrative: Milling ash logs. Dense wood, clean grain - satisfying precision.

refining_birch_log_to_plank.narrative: Processing birch. White wood with subtle grain - reveals silver interior.

refining_bronze_alloy.narrative: Creating bronze. Copper in core determines base, tin in surrounding modifies to alloy. T1 allows 1 core + 2 surrounding.

refining_clay_to_brick.narrative: Firing clay to brick. Soft earth becomes hard construction material.

refining_coal_to_charcoal.narrative: Processing coal to charcoal. Burns hotter, cleaner - essential for advanced work.

refining_copper_ore_to_ingot.narrative: Smelting raw copper. Foundation of metallurgy - heat purifies ore, impurities burn away.

refining_ebony_log_to_plank.narrative: Processing rare ebony. Black as night, hard as steel - exceptional quality.

refining_etherion_ore_to_ingot.narrative: Refining multidimensional metal. Reality bends - impossible configurations work.

refining_fire_steel.narrative: Infusing steel with fire. Metal burns without consumption - crystals seep energy in.

refining_frost_steel.narrative: Forging steel with frost. Perpetually cold metal - crystallizing impossible cold.

refining_gold_ore_to_ingot.narrative: Smelting gold ore. Soft lustrous metal - eternal and untarnishing.

refining_hide_to_leather.narrative: Tanning hide to leather. Curing and treating makes it durable and workable.

refining_iron_ore_to_ingot.narrative: Smelting iron ore. Backbone of civilization - each cylinder reveals metal within stone.

refining_ironwood_log_to_plank.narrative: Milling legendary ironwood. Dense as metal - cylinders strain against it.

refining_lightning_copper.narrative: Infusing copper with storm. Perfect conductivity - arcs jump between shards and metal.

refining_limestone_to_quicklime.narrative: Calcining limestone. Creates reactive quicklime - foundation of many processes.

refining_maple_log_to_plank.narrative: Processing maple logs. Light colored wood with fine grain - quality timber.

refining_mithril_ore_to_ingot.narrative: Refining legendary mithril. Metal purifies itself - cylinders align eagerly.

refining_oak_log_to_plank.narrative: Sawing oak into planks. Basic carpentry - blade sings as grain splits clean.

refining_orichalcum_ore_to_ingot.narrative: Refining ancient metal. Channels physical and magical forces - harmonic resonance.

refining_pine_log_to_plank.narrative: Processing pine logs. Soft wood cuts easily - resinous scent fills air.

refining_platinum_ore_to_ingot.narrative: Refining platinum ore. Dense white metal - rarer than gold, harder than steel.

refining_rarity_adamantine_epic.narrative: Refining rare adamantine to epic. Nearly indestructible becomes truly eternal.

refining_rarity_adamantine_legendary.narrative: Refining epic adamantine to legendary. Hardness beyond measurement.

refining_rarity_bronze_epic.narrative: Refining rare bronze to epic. Surpassing legendary smiths of old.

refining_rarity_bronze_rare.narrative: Refining uncommon bronze to rare. Ancient alloy perfected.

refining_rarity_copper_epic.narrative: Refining rare copper to epic. Approaching theoretical perfection.

refining_rarity_copper_legendary.narrative: Refining epic copper to legendary. Perfect molecular alignment achieved.

refining_rarity_copper_rare.narrative: Refining uncommon copper to rare. Grain becomes perfect - impurities purged.

refining_rarity_copper_uncommon.narrative: Refining common copper to uncommon. Four compress into one - structure perfects.

refining_rarity_etherion_mythical.narrative: Refining legendary etherion to mythical. Temporal boundaries dissolve.

refining_rarity_gold_rare.narrative: Refining uncommon gold to rare. Lustrous perfection achieved.

refining_rarity_iron_epic.narrative: Refining rare iron to epic. Bonds align with supernatural precision.

refining_rarity_iron_legendary.narrative: Refining epic iron to legendary. Ultimate iron - theoretically perfect.

refining_rarity_iron_rare.narrative: Refining uncommon iron to rare. Crystalline structure perfecting.

refining_rarity_iron_uncommon.narrative: Refining common iron to uncommon. Patient work and precise heat.

refining_rarity_mithril_epic.narrative: Refining rare mithril to epic. Weightless perfection approaches.

refining_rarity_mithril_legendary.narrative: Refining epic mithril to legendary. Defies physics completely.

refining_rarity_mithril_mythical.narrative: Refining legendary mithril to mythical. Metal sings in harmonic perfection.

refining_rarity_orichalcum_legendary.narrative: Refining epic orichalcum to legendary. Ancient metal awakens fully.

refining_rarity_orichalcum_mythical.narrative: Refining legendary orichalcum to mythical. Complete awakening achieved.

refining_rarity_platinum_legendary.narrative: Refining epic platinum to legendary. Ultimate precious metal perfection.

refining_rarity_silver_epic.narrative: Refining rare silver to epic. Magical conductivity maximizes.

refining_rarity_steel_epic.narrative: Refining rare steel to epic. Edge retention becomes legendary.

refining_rarity_steel_legendary.narrative: Refining epic steel to legendary. Perfect steel - master smiths weep.

refining_rarity_steel_rare.narrative: Refining uncommon steel to rare. Metal sings as imperfections vanish.

refining_rarity_steel_uncommon.narrative: Refining common steel to uncommon. Carbon bonds align perfectly.

refining_rarity_tin_epic.narrative: Refining rare tin to epic. Perfect magical conductivity achieved.

refining_rarity_tin_rare.narrative: Refining uncommon tin to rare. Silvery sheen becomes mirror-bright.

refining_sand_to_glass.narrative: Melting sand to glass. Extreme heat transforms granules to clarity.

refining_silver_ore_to_ingot.narrative: Refining silver ore. Gleaming white metal - resonates with unseen forces.

refining_steel_ore_to_ingot.narrative: Forging steel from carbon-rich ore. Requires intense heat - cylinders resist then yield.

refining_tin_ore_to_ingot.narrative: Refining tin ore. Essential for alloys - cylinders click with different tone than iron.

refining_worldtree_log_to_plank.narrative: Working worldtree wood. It remembers being part of something greater.

smithing_alchemy_table_t1.narrative: Basic alchemy table with mortar, pestle, and glassware.

smithing_alchemy_table_t2.narrative: Professional alchemy setup with distillation equipment and precise measuring tools.

smithing_alchemy_table_t3.narrative: Master alchemy laboratory with crystalline distillation chambers and self-regulating temperature controls.

smithing_alchemy_table_t4.narrative: Legendary alchemy apparatus that bends the laws of chemistry. Can create potions that defy natural law.

smithing_bamboo_fishing_rod.narrative: Flexible bamboo rod with silk line and bronze hook. Patience and the right tool can pull dinner from any water.

smithing_composite_longbow.narrative: Crafting a composite bow requires laminating different materials - wood for flexibility, sinew for power, silk for the string. Patience yields deadly accuracy.

smithing_copper_axe.narrative: Basic axe for woodcutting. Simple but essential for any aspiring adventurer.

smithing_copper_dagger.narrative: A dagger is deceptively simple - just a blade and a grip. But the balance must be perfect for quick, precise strikes.

smithing_copper_fire_ring.narrative: Simple copper band with fire crystal. Radiates gentle warmth.

smithing_copper_pickaxe.narrative: Your first pickaxe. The gateway to greater resources and deeper discoveries.

smithing_copper_spear.narrative: Simple spear with copper tip. Keep your enemies at a distance.

smithing_enchanting_table_t1.narrative: Simple enchanting table with basic rune-carving tools. Sufficient for minor enchantments.

smithing_enchanting_table_t2.narrative: Arcane enchanting table surrounded by floating crystals. Channels magical energies precisely.

smithing_enchanting_table_t3.narrative: Master enchanting table with floating crystal matrices and perfect rune alignment tools.

smithing_enchanting_table_t4.narrative: Legendary enchanting nexus that taps into the fabric of reality itself. Can imbue items with powers beyond mortal understanding.

smithing_engineering_bench_t1.narrative: Basic workbench for assembling mechanical devices.

smithing_engineering_bench_t2.narrative: Precision engineering station with specialized tools for complex device assembly.

smithing_engineering_bench_t3.narrative: Master engineering station with precision measurement tools and automated assembly assistance.

smithing_engineering_bench_t4.narrative: Legendary engineering workshop that incorporates arcane machinery. Can craft devices that blur the line between magic and technology.

smithing_fire_crystal_staff.narrative: Binding a fire crystal to ironwood creates a conduit for elemental power. The wood never burns, the crystal never dims - a perfect symbiosis.

smithing_forge_t1.narrative: Basic stone forge suitable for working copper and iron. The foundation of smithing.

smithing_forge_t2.narrative: Improved forge with better heat retention. Can work steel reliably.

smithing_forge_t3.narrative: Master forge with crystal enhancement. Can reach extreme temperatures.

smithing_forge_t4.narrative: Legendary forge that bends reality itself. Can work metals that shouldn't exist.

smithing_iron_axe.narrative: Solid iron axe for serious forestry work. Bites deep and true.

smithing_iron_boots.narrative: Reinforced leather boots with iron caps. Protects your feet without slowing you down.

smithing_iron_chestplate.narrative: Iron plates protect vital organs. Heavy but reliable.

smithing_iron_pickaxe.narrative: Upgraded pickaxe that can tackle tougher deposits. Iron reliability meets practical design.

smithing_iron_round_shield.narrative: A simple round shield - iron face with oak backing. Protects and strikes in equal measure.

smithing_iron_shortsword.narrative: The foundational smithing technique - blade, tang, handle. Simple in concept, demanding in execution. Every smith remembers their first sword.

smithing_iron_studded_gauntlets.narrative: Reinforced leather gloves with iron studs across the knuckles. Your hands are your tools - protect them properly.

smithing_iron_warhammer.narrative: Crafting a warhammer is about managing weight distribution. The crushing head must be perfectly balanced on the shaft, or it becomes a liability rather than a weapon.

smithing_iron_water_amulet.narrative: Iron amulet holding a water crystal. Feels cool against your skin.

smithing_leather_tunic.narrative: Basic leather protection. Better than nothing, lighter than metal.

smithing_mithril_axe.narrative: Ethereal mithril axe that phases through wood fibers. Cuts with minimal resistance.

smithing_mithril_dagger.narrative: Mithril dagger that seems to shimmer out of existence. Wickedly sharp, impossibly light.

smithing_mithril_fishing_rod.narrative: Mithril-tipped rod with enchanted line. The magical construction senses fish before they bite.

smithing_mithril_pickaxe.narrative: Legendary mithril pickaxe that sings through stone. Impossibly light yet incredibly effective.

smithing_pine_shortbow.narrative: Simple pine bow strung with treated sinew. Not powerful, but reliable.

smithing_refinery_t1.narrative: Basic refinery for turning raw ores into usable ingots. Essential for any metalworker.

smithing_refinery_t2.narrative: Advanced refinery with better efficiency and heat control.

smithing_refinery_t3.narrative: Master refinery capable of processing legendary materials. Obsidian crucibles contain extreme temperatures.

smithing_refinery_t4.narrative: Legendary refinery that exists partially outside normal reality. Can process materials that shouldn't be refinable.

smithing_reinforced_fishing_rod.narrative: Sturdy oak rod reinforced with steel fittings. Handles heavier catches and reaches deeper waters.

smithing_steel_axe.narrative: Razor-edged steel axe. Ancient trees fall before it.

smithing_steel_battleaxe.narrative: Forging a steel battleaxe requires balance - too heavy and it's unwieldy, too light and it lacks impact. This versatile weapon can devastate with two hands or still threaten with one.

smithing_steel_helm.narrative: Steel helm with full face protection. Your head stays attached, which is nice.

smithing_steel_leggings.narrative: Steel plate leggings with articulated joints. Protecting your legs without sacrificing mobility is the mark of quality armor.

smithing_steel_lightning_bracelet.narrative: Steel bracelet with lightning shard. Crackles with stored static.

smithing_steel_longsword.narrative: Balanced steel longsword. The blade flows like water, strikes like thunder.

smithing_steel_pickaxe.narrative: Steel pickaxe with perfect balance. Makes hard rock feel like clay.

smithing_steel_sickle.narrative: Curved steel blade perfect for harvesting delicate plants. Clean cuts preserve quality and maximize yield.

smithing_worldtree_fishing_rod.narrative: Legendary rod crafted from worldtree branches and etherion. The line knows where fish will be.
